storage: Keep in an airtight tin or zip pouch at room temperature, away from damp; re-crisp in a dry pan or microwave 30 to 40 sec if it softens.
looksLike: Tiny, white, very light and hollow puffs of rice that crunch and go soft quickly in moisture. Sold plain or salted; the plain kind is used for bhel.
howToPick: Choose white, dry, light puffs that snap crisply. Avoid damp, chewy, yellowish or unusually bright-white puffs; a consumer-health page seen in an earlier run warned that urea or bleaching agents are sometimes used to make puffed rice look very white in the Indian market (treat as a caution only).
shelfLife: A few months sealed per typical pack labels (general guidance; not taken from a source in this run), but it softens within hours once the pack is open in humid weather.
